final.memo:
The Company represents a classic, misunderstood pharmaceutical conglomerate where market focus on short-term GAAP volatility and integration noise masks a high-quality business with significant earnings power [D05, D06]. While the market is currently distracted by litigation uncertainty and integration costs, the underlying adjusted margins of 37.3% reveal a strong competitive position in both branded and generic segments [D06].

Our sum-of-the-parts analysis suggests the current valuation is disconnected from the business's potential. By applying a conservative 25x multiple to the 2015 adjusted EPS guidance of $4.55, we arrive at a target price of $113.75, which highlights a compelling risk/reward skew of 30% upside against a historical floor of $70.00 [D03, D04].

The mispricing persists because the market is prioritizing current GAAP accounting over the structural simplification underway [D05, D06]. We believe the path to a re-rating lies in management successfully executing the divestiture of the Men’s/Prostate Health business, which will immediately reduce leverage and improve the quality of the remaining core [D03].

We are looking for management to provide a clear, granular roadmap for synergy realization and a bridge between their adjusted earnings metrics and GAAP results [D05, D06]. We are prepared to engage constructively to ensure these goals are met, though we will not hesitate to escalate to public advocacy if initial milestones are missed [D04].

While we are mindful of the litigation risks and integration hurdles, we find the floor supported by the historical pharmaceutical valuation range [D04, D05]. We are initiating a position at 2% of NAV with the intent to scale to 5% as we gain conviction in the integration timeline and synergy realization [D05].
